svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · ACTIVATION CHECKPOINTING & OFFLOAD ARCHITECTURE (#370)
Full Recomputation vs. Selective Checkpointing vs. Async PCIe Gen5 Offload
Saving expensive Linear GEMMs + Async PCIe Gen5 DMA Offload avoids the +33.3% Full Recompute FLOP penalty (57.8% MFU)
Tier 2 Trap: Full Layer Checkpointing (+33% FLOPs)
• Discards all intra-layer activations, saving only layer boundary x_l
• Re-runs every QKV, Out & SwiGLU MLP GEMM during backward
• Inflates training FLOPs from 6ND to 8ND (+33.3% compute tax!)
• Drags Effective Model MFU Down to 42.5% on 16K Context
Tier 4: Selective Op + Async PCIe Gen5 Offload
• Recomputes only low-FLOP / high-byte ops (FlashAttention LSE, SiLU)
• Never recomputes expensive Linear GEMMs (only +3.2% extra FLOPs)
• Streams saved GEMM inputs to Host RAM over 56 GB/s PCIe 5.0 DMA
• Only 7.8 GB HBM Footprint & 57.8% Effective MFU (+36% faster)
4-Tier Activation Memory & Recomputation Matrix (70B Training · 16K Context · H100 80GB)
Tier 1 (No Checkpointing) : Act HBM = 98.0 GB (OOM) | Extra FLOPs = 0.0% | Effective MFU = 0.0% (OOM)
Tier 2 (Full Layer Checkpointing) : Act HBM = 11.5 GB (Fit) | Extra FLOPs = 33.3% | Effective MFU = 42.5%
Tier 3 (Selective Op Recompute) : Act HBM = 21.0 GB (Fit) | Extra FLOPs = 4.5% | Effective MFU = 53.6%
Tier 4 (Selective + PCIe 5 Offload): Act HBM = 7.8 GB (Fit) | Extra FLOPs = 3.2% | Effective MFU = 57.8%
